summary.headline: Planetary Causes of Death
summary.text: Astrological judgments on causes and circumstances of death: impeded or dignified Venus, Mercury, and Moon indicate specific ailments, poisons, foods, counsel, and planetary causes, while the planets’ houses, exaltations, falls, descents, and retrogradation determine whether death occurs at home, abroad, by falling, drowning, or strangulation.
